spoken_text: Both new campaigns are live and healthy, and spend is well under budget. Today so far, the two campaigns combined spent about four dollars and forty-four cents against a thirty-dollar daily cap, and the trailing seven days ran a hundred seventeen dollars against a two-hundred-ten-dollar weekly cap. The Samples campaign is the efficient lane — it's the only one with a verified Google Ads paid lead, Tiara on the twenty-seventh, at a cost per lead of about fifty-one dollars, under our seventy-five-dollar threshold. Contract Manufacturing spends more, roughly sixty-six dollars this week, but has zero verified paid leads and a higher cost per click. Today's two inbound leads were both organic and unattributed, so no verified paid leads today. My one recommendation is to hold budgets steady but fix the search-term reporting gap so we can start cutting wasted spend on Contract Manufacturing — no budget change and no approval needed.
